message: Generic type 'LinkDirective' is not supported. Consider using a concrete type instead.
Entity 'User' has fields that its references do not carry (homepage), but no reference resolver. Define one with defineResolveReference<User>.
Directive '@link' has the same name as a directive that federation adds to the subgraph schema
Directive '@key' has the same name as a directive that federation adds to the subgraph schema
